identificationModule.briefTitle: P1101 in Treating Patients With Early PMF or Overt PMF at Low or Intermediate-1 Risk
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Multicenter Phase III Study to Assess Efficacy and Safety of Ropeginterferon Alfa-2b (P1101) in Adult Patients With Pre-fibrotic/Early Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF) or Overt PMF at Low or Intermediate-1 Risk According to DIPSS Plus (HOPE-PMF): The Core Study and Its Extension Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a phase 3 double-blind clinical trial arm to test Ropeginterferon alfa-2b (P1101) in adult patients with Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF) at early stage or low to medium risk.

Participants will receive the study drug/placebo bi-weekly and have an assessment visit every 4 weeks. The ratio of study drug to placebo group is 2:1.

armGroups.label: Ropeginterferon alfa-2b (P1101)
armGroups.description: Ropeginterferon alfa-2b (P1101) is administrated subcutaneously (SC) every two weeks (± 3 days) until 80 weeks.

armGroups.label: Placebo control
armGroups.description: Placebo is administrated subcutaneously (SC) every two weeks (± 3 days) until 80 weeks.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo is a look-alike substance with the intervention (Ropeginterferon alfa-2b) that contains no active drug.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with Platelet count equal or less (≤) 400 × 10^9/L
primaryOutcomes.description: Platelet count ≤400 × 10\^9/L is one of the criteria for clinically relevant complete hematologic response (CrCHR).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with White Blood Cells (WBC) count equal or less (≤) 10 × 10^9/L
primaryOutcomes.description: White Blood Cells (WBC) count ≤10 × 10\^9/L is one of the criteria for clinically relevant complete hematologic response (CrCHR).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with Hemoglobin (Hgb) equal or greater (≧) 10.0 g/dL
primaryOutcomes.description: Peripheral blood: Hemoglobin (Hgb) ≧ 10.0 g/dL is one of the criteria for clinically relevant complete hematologic response (CrCHR).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants absence of major thrombotic events
primaryOutcomes.description: The absence of major thrombotic events during the observation time frame is one of the criteria for clinically relevant complete hematologic response (CrCHR).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with no progression to secondary acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
primaryOutcomes.description: The absence of progression to secondary acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is one of the criteria for clinically relevant complete hematologic remission (CrCHR).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with no progression on the Total Symptom Score (TSS)
primaryOutcomes.description:
The TSS score is utilized to evaluate clinical symptoms, which is based on the MFSAF Total Symptom Score (TSS) form v4.0.

No progression is defined as:

* The participants who still have a TSS score equal to or less than (≤) 10 If the baseline score is ≤ 10.
* The participants with a TSS score no increase than 50% If the baseline score is greater than (\&amp;gt;) 10.
